rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the L1.4 hand-off-honesty fix that followed the owner's holdout4 review; never use it to tune prompts, retrieval, policies or scorer thresholds.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout5.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json, holdout.json, holdout2.json, holdout3.json and holdout4.json (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout4 (consumed 2026-11-02: gate passed 8/8 by the pattern scorer, then the owner's review found unbacked follow-up promises, undisclosed tool failures and unbacked 'shortly'; the engine and scorer were changed after seeing those results).
